title: Pill Toast
description: A physics-based toast that grows from a small pill into a card with a description and an action, gooey-morphing between shapes, with promise states, swipe, hover and keyboard dismissal.

loop.script: click[0] → wait → wait → click[2] → wait → wait

props.name: position
props.description: PillToaster: the corner or edge toasts stack from. Positions are physical (right is right in both reading directions); toasts open away from that edge.

props.name: theme
props.description: PillToaster: with a theme, toasts take its fill (near-black for light, near-white for dark; system follows the OS). Without one the fill is white and the text takes the page color.

props.name: offset
props.type: number | string | { top?, right?, bottom?, left? }
props.description: PillToaster: distance from the viewport edges, in pixels or any CSS length.

props.name: options
props.description: PillToaster: defaults merged into every toast (fill, roundness, styles, duration).

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: PillToaster: Escape dismisses the focused toast, or the newest one.

props.name: pillToast.show / .success / .error / .warning / .info / .action
props.description: Show a toast and get its id. options: { title?, description?, type?, position?, duration?, icon?, fill?, roundness?, autopilot?, button?: { title, onClick }, styles?: { title?, description?, badge?, button? } }. An existing id is updated in place.

props.name: pillToast.promise
props.type: (promise, { loading, success, error, action?, position? }) => Promise
props.description: A loading toast that becomes the success, error or action toast when the promise settles. Each state is an options object or a function of the result.

props.name: pillToast.dismiss / .clear
props.description: Dismiss one toast, or clear every toast (of one position).

a11y: Every toast and update is also announced through a persistent pair of visually hidden live regions: assertive (role=alert) for errors and warnings, polite (role=status) for the rest, with the title, the description and the action label. The toasts themselves are not live regions, so nothing is spoken twice.

A toast with a description is a focusable named group (named by its title): keyboard focus opens it, pauses its timer and reaches its action, a real button. Escape dismisses the focused toast, or the newest one when focus is elsewhere. Upstream's toast was a button holding an action link (nested interactive controls); the root is a div here.
The status icons and the gooey canvas are decorative (aria-hidden); the title carries the meaning, and each state also has its own color and icon.
Reduced motion: the pill and card jump to their end shapes, the title swap and the spinner lose their motion, and the toast appears without the slide.

Contrast on request: the default keeps upstream's state colors, whose titles on the white and near-white fills are below 4.5:1 (success, warning, info and others). Under prefers-contrast: more the state colors darken (or lighten on the dark fill) to at least 4.5:1, and the description text strengthens; under forced colors the toast uses Canvas, CanvasText and an outline. Set --pill-toast-state-<state> to change them for everyone.
Right to left: titles, badges and descriptions read right to left; the pill and the toast stay anchored to the physical position you pass.
usage: pillToast.success({ title: "Changes saved", description: "Your profile is up to date." })
